en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 296- Husain bin Ubaidullah narrates from Abu Ja’far Muhammad bin Sufyan Bazufari from Ahmad bin Idris from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa from Hasan bin Ali Faddal from Abdullah bin Bukair from Zurarah that he said:

I spoke about Humran bin Ayyin and Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s) said: By Allah, he would definitely never apostatize. Then he paused for sometime and then said: Yes, Humran would definitely never apostatize and become a heretic.
